# Glossary 

BC; backstroke

BR; breaststroke

BF; butterlfy

CT; cut off time

COSASC; City of Sunderland Amateur Swimming Club

DQ; disqualified

FC; front crawl

FF; Flying fish - entry level sqaud

FS; freestyle (typically swum as front crawl)

IM; individual medley (each swimmer swims all strokes in one event)

LC; long course (50m)

N&D's; Northumberland and Durham Swimming Association competitions

NERs; North East regional galas

NST; Newcastle Swim Team

PB; personal best time

SC; short course (25m)

T&P; Tiger Sharks and Pirahnas squads

QT; qualifying time 

UCT; upper cut off time
